h1: A website chatbot that answers in your voice
overview: We add a chat window to your website that answers visitor questions using your own pages, products and policies, in a tone that suits your brand. We set it up on your site, test it with real questions and make it pass tricky ones to your team by email. You get a short guide for changing its answers and turning it off whenever you wish.

faq: Which website platforms does it work on?
Shopify, WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, Framer and custom sites. If you can paste a small code snippet or install an app on your site, we can add the chat window.
We set it to answer only from your content and to say it does not know when it is unsure. We test with questions it should not answer and fix any weak spots before launch.
Our price covers set-up. Chat tools and model usage are billed to you by the providers, and we tell you the expected monthly cost for your traffic before we start.
Can visitors speak to a real person?
Yes. We add a clear option to reach your team, and the chat is passed on with the conversation attached. We do not hide that visitors are talking to an automated assistant.
